title: Italian-Style Kidney Bean Jjigae
description: A unique fusion of Italian and Korean flavors, combining kidney beans with jovial spices and a hint of Indian flair.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add kidney beans, diced tomatoes, tomato paste, jjigae paste, and italian seasoning.
Stir well to combine and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
